'''Veron''' was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] located in the [[Veron system/Legends|Veron system]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Senex-Juvex Loop]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Cyimarra system/Legends|Cyimarra]] and [[Presteen system/Legends|Presteen systems]], while the [[Veron Route]] connected it to the [[New Cylimba system/Legends|New Cylimba system]] of the [[D'Aelgoth sector/Legends|D'Aelgoth sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

Veron was dominated by [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] of the [[House Araba]], which was based on the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cyimarra]]. The agriworld shared its name with<ref name="TEA" /> [[Veron Minor]], a planet<ref name="Planets">''[[The Star Wars Planets Collection]]''</ref> in the [[Mektrun sector/Legends|Mektrun sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on the corresponding data for [[Mektrun Cluster/Legends|Mektrun Cluster]] and [[Veron Minor system/Legends|Veron Minor system]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Veron was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" />

A planet named "Veron" was originally introduced in ''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]'', a [[1991]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', which placed it in the [[Mektrun Cluster/Legends|Mektrun Cluster]].<ref name="PoG1">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''</ref> In ''The Essential Atlas'', both a "Veron" [[Star system/Legends|system]] and a "[[Veron Minor system/Legends|Veron Minor]]" system were listed,<ref name="TEA" /> and in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to that book, both the Mektrun Cluster and the Veron Minor system were placed in the Mektrun [[Sector/Legends|sector]], thereby confirming that the original planet Veron had been [[Retroactive continuity|retroactively]] renamed Veron Minor.<ref name="EAOC" />
